games.title: DayZ: Badlands
games.note: October 2026 arid expansion for DayZ set across Nasdara—a 267 km² desert frontier on the western edge of Takistan—introducing sandstorms, drought and heatstroke survival, motorbikes, rebuildable outposts, and Morse-code radio scavenging.

games.title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
games.note: 50-vs-50 platoon-scale Vietnam War tactical shooter launched in August 2026, bringing asymmetric jungle tunnel ambushes, river patrol boats, Huey helicopter air-cavalry insertions, and squad radio coordination to Hell Let Loose's frontline formula.

games.title: The Battle of Polytopia
games.note: Created in Stockholm by Felix Ekenstam's indie studio Midjiwan, distilling Civilization-style 4X exploration, tech trees, and asymmetric tribe warfare into crisp, 30-minute low-poly turn-based matches across phones, PC, Switch, and even car dashboards.

links.took: DayZ's high-stakes permadeath scavenging, medical trauma simulation, and tense player-encounter stories
links.added: A 267 km² Takistani desert frontier (Nasdara) with drought, sandstorm, and heatstroke mechanics, motorbikes, and Morse-code radio stashes
